answers.answer: The initial draw deck is the player's 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards shuffled together. Put the 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot. Set the Gear pawn to 1st gear, then draw 7 cards into hand.
answers.evidence: Setup: “Shuffle your 12 Speed cards, 3 Starting Upgrade cards, and 3 Stress cards together as your draw deck”; “Place 6 Heat cards face up on the Engine spot”; “Set Gear pawn to 1st gear”; “Draw 7 cards into your hand.”

answers.answer: Yes, you may stay in your current gear. Shifting from 1st to 3rd is shifting two positions and costs 1 Heat immediately during Shift Gears, by moving a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile. You must have that Heat available to pay.
answers.evidence: Shift Gears: “Stay in your current gear, or shift up or down one position for free. You may instead shift two positions by immediately paying 1 Heat during this step: move a Heat card from your Engine to your discard pile.”

answers.answer: No. In 3rd gear you must play 3 cards, and you play them face down.
answers.evidence: Play Cards: “Play cards from hand face down equal to your gear number (… 3rd = 3 …).”

answers.answer: Steps 1 and 2 (Shift Gears and Play Cards) are simultaneous for all players, in that order. Everyone must finish both before step 3 begins. Steps 3–9 are then sequential: each player completes all of them before the next player's step 3. Resolve in front-car-first order; when cars are side by side, the car closest to the Race Line acts first.
answers.evidence: Turn Structure: “All players complete steps 1 and 2 simultaneously, in that order. Wait until everyone has finished both steps before starting step 3.” Sequential Phase: “Each player completes all of steps 3–9 before the next player begins step 3”; side-by-side, the car “closest to the Race Line is ahead for all purposes, including turn order.”

answers.answer: Cars never block passage. If both spots in your destination space are occupied, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars. When placing a car, use the spot closest to the Race Line if that spot is available.
answers.evidence: Special Rules: “Cars never block passage, but if your destination space is full, place your car in the first free spot behind the blocking cars.” Reveal & Move: “Place your car on the spot closest to the Race Line if available.”

answers.answer: The flipped Heat and Starting Upgrade cards are immediately discarded as non-Speed cards. The Speed 3 card goes in your Play Area on top of the played Stress card and supplies speed 3 for that Stress. The played Stress stays underneath and both are discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve played Stress cards before moving on to Adrenaline.
answers.evidence: Stress Cards: flip until a Speed appears; “Immediately discard each flipped non-Speed card, including Heat, Stress and Starting Upgrade cards.” The found Speed is placed “on top of the played Stress card”; “its value supplies that Stress card's speed”; both are discarded during Replenish Hand. Resolve all played Stress cards before Adrenaline.

answers.answer: With five cars that started the race, the last two cars to move receive Adrenaline. It gives access to 1 extra Cooldown and the option to add 1 extra speed. The extra speed may be taken before or after Boost. Unused Adrenaline cannot be saved for another round.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: “If the race started with 5 or more cars, the last two cars to move receive these benefits”; the benefits are “1 extra Cooldown” and “1 extra speed”; extra speed may be taken “before or after Boost”; unused Adrenaline “cannot be saved for another round.”

answers.answer: Yes. In 2nd gear, Cooldown 1 lets you move one Heat card from your hand back to your Engine. During React you may then immediately spend it from the Engine to Boost, paying it to the discard pile. This is permitted because Cooldown can be activated before Boost, and the summary explicitly allows cooling Heat into the Engine and immediately spending it to Boost.
answers.evidence: Actions—Cooldown: “Move Heat cards from your hand back to your Engine”; 2nd gear has “Cooldown 1.” Paying Heat requires it to be in the Engine. React says: “You may Cooldown Heat from your hand into your Engine, then immediately spend it to Boost.”

answers.answer: You may Boost once per turn during React. It costs 1 Heat from your Engine to the discard pile. If your Engine is empty, you cannot choose to Boost unless you first use available Cooldown during React to return Heat from hand to Engine. To determine Boost speed, flip cards from your draw deck, discarding each non-Speed card until a Speed card appears; add that Speed card to your Play Area and move its value. Boost speed counts toward total speed for corner checks.
answers.evidence: Boost: “Once per turn during React, pay 1 Heat from Engine to discard”; flip until a Speed card appears and “move its value.” Paying Heat: cannot Boost without Engine Heat, but may first use Cooldown. Boost “increases your total speed for corner checks.”

answers.answer: Slipstream is optional. For the corner crossed during Slipstream, check your total speed of 6, not the extra two spaces of Slipstream movement; the summary says Slipstream movement does not increase speed for corner checks. Against limit 4, pay 2 Heat if you have enough.
answers.evidence: Slipstream: “optionally move 2 spaces forward” and it “does NOT increase your speed for corner checks, but crossing a Corner Line this way still requires checking that corner.” Check Corner: pay Heat equal to speed in excess of the limit.

answers.answer: Check both corners, in the order crossed. Use the same total speed, 8, for each: pay 2 Heat for the limit-6 corner and 4 Heat for the limit-4 corner, for 6 Heat altogether.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: “Check every Corner Line crossed this turn … in the order crossed”; “For each corner separately,” compare total speed and pay the excess; “Use the same total speed for each corner.”

answers.answer: You owe 3 Heat for the limit-4 corner at speed 7, but have only 2, so you spin out. Move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile. Move your car back to the first available space before the corner that caused the spin out. Take 2 extra Stress cards directly into your hand because you were in 4th gear, then move your Gear pawn to 1st gear.
answers.evidence: Check Corner: pay the excess (7 − 4 = 3). Spin Out: “If you cannot pay enough Heat … move all remaining Engine Heat to your discard pile”; move back to the first available space before that corner; take 2 Stress in 3rd/4th gear “directly into your hand”; set gear to 1st.

answers.answer: You may discard unwanted Speed cards during the optional Discard step, but may never discard Stress or Heat cards. You may not browse any discard pile, including your own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge.
answers.evidence: Discard: “Optionally discard unwanted cards from hand, but never Stress or Heat cards. Nobody may browse any discard pile, including their own; only the top card of each pile is public knowledge.”

answers.answer: Move all cards in your Play Area to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7; you do not draw seven additional cards.
answers.evidence: Replenish Hand: “Move all Play Area cards to your discard pile, then draw only enough cards to bring your hand back to 7. Do not draw seven additional cards.”

answers.answer: Shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted Stress flips. Cards still in your Play Area are not included because they have not yet been discarded.
answers.evidence: Running Out of Cards: when the draw deck is empty, “immediately shuffle your discard pile into a new draw deck, then continue the interrupted draws or flips.” “Do not include cards still in your Play Area; they have not yet been discarded.”

answers.answer: When paying Heat, move it from your Engine to your discard pile. It can cycle from discard to draw deck to hand, then return to your Engine only via Cooldown. Heat cards cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.
answers.evidence: Paying Heat: “move that many Heat cards from your Engine to your discard pile.” Heat Card Cycle: “Heat moves from Engine to discard to draw deck to hand; only returns to Engine via Cooldown.” Heat cards cannot normally be played or voluntarily discarded from hand.

answers.answer: Commit the two playable cards and fill the two remaining required slots with Heat cards in your Play Area. Your car moves zero spaces. Set your gear to 1st, discard all committed cards, including the covering Heat cards, and skip directly to step 9 to replenish. You skip React, so you cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.
answers.evidence: Cluttered Hand: commit all playable cards and fill remaining slots with Heat cards; “Your car moves zero spaces”; set gear to 1st, discard all committed cards, and skip to step 9. “You skip React, so cannot Cooldown or Boost this turn.”

answers.answer: The car that crossed first does not automatically win based on crossing order. If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins; if tied, the car closest to the Race Line wins. At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: “If multiple cars finish in the same round, the car furthest ahead wins (closest to Race Line breaks ties).” “At the end of the round, remove all cars that crossed the final finish line and place them in finishing order on the Hall of Fame.”

answers.answer: No. On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line or after crossing it. After crossing the final finish line, ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.
answers.evidence: Scoring / Victory Conditions: “On the final lap, you cannot Slipstream across the finish line, and cannot Slipstream after crossing it.” After crossing, “ignore the speed limits of corners beyond it and move as far as you can.”

answers.answer: Both remaining cars receive Adrenaline if they are the last two to move. Eligibility is determined by the six cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track, so the race still meets the five-or-more-car threshold.
answers.evidence: Adrenaline: when the race started with 5 or more cars, “the last two cars to move receive these benefits”; “Use the number of cars that started the race, even after finishers leave the track.”
